lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y8Mg4Fe4 (Y2MgFe) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 119), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Mg each adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors, while Y centers have 16 neighbors, involving Fe, Mg, and Y. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Fe and Mg 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Y 16-vertex polyhedra.
